name: memoriaflash-agent

scripts.admin:audit: tsx -e "import { runDatabaseAudit } from './src/server/contentAgent/admin/databaseAudit'; runDatabaseAudit().then(x => console.log(JSON.stringify(x,null,2))).catch(e => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); })"
